research_notes: Professional certifications are separated from course-completion certificates, free learning badges, and assessments.
Prices may vary by country, tax, promotions, and checkout. Where not confirmed, the file says so rather than guessing.
Role mappings are relevance suggestions, not guarantees of job qualification.
This is a curated first batch for the domain, not an exhaustive list of every possible credential.
Credentials and pricing should be rechecked on official pages before purchase.
